bullets_en: Payal Rohatagi calls actor Imran Khan ‘jobless actor’.
Manne Krishank challenges Revanth Reddy to debate Medicover links.
Odisha government announces to hold student union election after a gap of eight years.
Trump cites Indian election that didn't happen to call U.S. electoral process ‘corrupt’.
Bihar MLC polls: JD(U) faces dissent; RLM to back own candidate.
bullets_ur: Payal Rohatagi ne adakar Imran Khan ko ‘jobless actor’ keh diya.
Manne Krishank ne Revanth Reddy ko Medicover links par behas ka challenge diya.
Odisha hukumat ne aath saal ke waqfay ke baad student union intikhabat karane ka elaan kar diya.
Trump ne na honay walay Indian election ka hawala de kar U.S. intikhabi amal ko ‘corrupt’ keh diya.
Bihar MLC intikhabat: JD(U) ko ikhtilafat ka samna; RLM apne umeedwar ki himayat karegi.
